title: Penovác's Cats
content: Endre Penovác (Serbia, b. 1956) paints cats using a unique wet-into-wet technique.He uses a wet-in-wet technique, which involves applying wet paint to a pre-wetted surface. This approach allows the pigments to blend and spread organically, creating soft, ethereal effects.More about how he paints these catson my Substack post
